description: Technical indicators for a Solana token (by mint, or SOL/BTC/ETH) or pool, computed from the same candles as price_history: RSI(14), SMA and EMA 20/50 with their latest cross, MACD(12,26,9), ATR(14) and Bollinger Bands(20,2), each with its value and a short neutral reading of how it is conventionally interpreted (e.g. RSI above 70 is often called overbought). Descriptive only: indicators describe past prices and don't predict. Uses up to 300 candles. Fails (and is not charged) if no source has candles. Costs $0.005 USDC per call.

aggregate.description: Candles per bar: minute 1, 5 or 15; hour 1, 4 or 12; day 1 (default 1)

pool.description: A specific Solana pool address instead of the token's top pool

token.description: Solana token mint address, or SOL, BTC or ETH. Its most-traded pool is used
